scope: Read-only media/frame completeness audit; no production source, manifests, inventories or media changed.
notes: The full videos encode every retained native picture frame. They are not individual lossless PNG cache directories.
The 7,499 canonical CSV rows are numeric source-vs-GSAP comparison records, not 7,499 human/director explanations.
Selected final JPEGs are downsampled reference/reconstruction/difference triptychs; 24 JPEGs per film are not every frame.
Scene asset images are cropped pieces/materials, not full-canvas source or final frame sequences.
Fourteen atlas JPEGs contain84selected source/rebuild teaching pairs, not an exhaustive motion taxonomy.
